Step 1: 1408 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1400 mod 400 = 100, so 1400 not leap, but 1408 is leap).  
Step 2: From 02-21-1408:  
Days in Feb 1408 = 29, so 29 - 21 = 8 days left in Feb.  
March: 31 days, April: 30, May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, August: 31.  
Step 3: Cumulative: 8 (Feb) + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 = 192 days to Aug 31.  
We need only 130 days from Feb 21.  
130 - 8 = 122 days after Feb 29.  
122 - 31 (Mar) = 91  
91 - 30 (Apr) = 61  
61 - 31 (May) = 30  
30 - 30 (Jun) = 0 → exactly end of June.  
So new date is 1408-06-30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1408-06-30
